title: Hoshino Ichika — Connecting Tones〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello. Please come in.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion. I really appreciate you having me again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure.
Also, I heard that you finished your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I did!
And I wanted to thank you for your advice, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me. If anything, you gave me the inspiration for another song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, please...!
But that does make me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, as a small token of my appreciation...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here are some mini cream puffs. I was thinking that you'd like to have something sweet while you work, or whenever you need a little boost of energy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's so thoughtful of you.
Thank you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll have one right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, I'll make some tea.
Please sit and relax, you two.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
Would you mind if I listened to your song, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Of course I wouldn't...!
I just need one second to get it set up!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This kindness... I get a clear feeling throughout the song that you want to help or support someone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's great, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was able to finish this song because of your help, Kanade. So, again, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Like I said, there's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I believe that you were able to finish your song because you were willing to take a hard look at it and never gave up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was also surprised when I heard that you were working on a song. It's impressive considering how much we usually practice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wanted to do this so that Saki wouldn't have to work as hard...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, to sing with Miku.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
To sing with Miku?
That's a very nice reason.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-It is...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Given how this was your first song, I was very impressed by how well-tuned Miku's voice was.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's clear that you care greatly about her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for the mini cream puffs. They were delicious.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm glad you liked them.
Well, to be fair, Honami helped pick them out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling that you're also going to like our other little gift.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Other little gift?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Honami told me about how she places some flowers in a vase after she finishes cleaning each time. I helped choose ones for today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind you chose.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Today's flowers are... Gerberas!
I chose these because they come in a variety of vibrant and beautiful colors, and most types symbolize optimism.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, just looking at all these beautiful colors is putting a smile on my face. Thank you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Ms. Mochizuki, you usually ask Hoshino for advice regarding which flowers to bring each time, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, Ichika knows quite a lot about flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your name came up a long time ago, but I finally have this opportunity to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for always choosing such lovely flowers, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, no, um! I just like thinking about what kinds of flowers people might like to receive! I really don't deserve to be thanked...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If anything, they're my way of thanking you. I mean, I owe you so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We've been thanking each other so much today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we have...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Ichika, I'll take the flowers.
Ms. Yoisaki, I'll place them in a vase now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want these gerberas to last as long as possible, so I promise to cherish them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, thank you... Wait, I did it again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe.
